dialog.criticalError.title: {appName} — Critical Error
dialog.preloadError.body:
{appName} failed to start (preload script error in {file}).

Please reinstall {appName}.

If the problem persists after reinstalling, please contact support.
dialog.selectModelFolder.title: Select Model Folder
dialog.singleInstance.message:
Only one instance of {appName} can run at a time.

Close the existing instance first, then try again.
dialog.singleInstance.title: {appName}
notify.app.config_load_failed_body: Config load failed. Settings were reset to defaults. Check the logs for details.
dialog.crashLoop.title: {appName} — Crash loop
dialog.crashLoop.mainBody:
The main window renderer has crashed repeatedly and cannot recover.

Please use the tray icon to Restart or Quit, then relaunch {appName}.
dialog.crashLoop.bubbleBody:
The bubble overlay renderer has crashed repeatedly and cannot recover.

Please use the tray icon to Restart or Quit, then relaunch {appName}.
dialog.pythonBackend.timeoutBody:
{appName} could not connect to its Python backend within {seconds} seconds.

Please check the logs and try again.
dialog.pythonBackend.crashSignalBody:
{appName}'s Python backend was terminated by a signal (likely SIGSEGV or SIGABRT) and will now exit.

Please check the logs and try again.
dialog.pythonBackend.crashExitBody:
{appName}'s Python backend exited unexpectedly with code {code} and will now exit.

Please check the logs and try again.
dialog.pythonBackend.earlyExitSuffix: Python backend exited early (code={code}). Check the logs.
dialog.pythonBackend.restartLoopBody:
{appName} has been asked to restart {count} times in the last {seconds} seconds, which suggests the Python backend is crashing on launch.

To avoid a crash loop, the automatic restart has been cancelled. Please check the log files in your {appName} config directory (python_crash.*.txt and voice-typer.log), then start {appName} manually once you've addressed the underlying issue.
